fields.label: Animate the shell in on start
fields.description: Fade the wallpaper in and grow the frame, bar and notch into place when the shell starts (boot or reload). Off makes everything appear at once, as stock.

fields.label: Enter duration, milliseconds
fields.description: Base time E for the way in: the frame takes E, the bar, notch and dock start after 0.45 E and take E, the wallpaper fade takes 1.4 E.

fields.label: Leave duration, milliseconds
fields.description: Base time L for the way out before a reload (via `ambxst run reload`, the cleanload IPC target, or the optional ambxst wrapper): bar, notch and dock take 0.85 L, the frame starts after 0.2 L and takes L, the wallpaper fade starts after 0.1 L and takes 1.4 L. Everything eases in and out.

fields.label: Cover a cold kill with the veil helper
fields.description: Keep a tiny detached helper that, if the shell is killed without leaving first (a plain `ambxst reload` with no wrapper), shows the last wallpaper and frame and plays the leave animation itself, then holds the background colour until the new shell is up. Needs a reload to start or stop the helper.

fields.label: On-screen display (volume, microphone, brightness)
fields.description: Quiet at start: the pop-up is not shown for the reports the services make while reading their initial state after a start (the volume and microphone sync during the first seconds, and each monitor's first brightness read, which on DDC monitors can land many seconds in); real changes still show it. As stock: always show it. Off: never show it.
